details: The package simple-date-formatter-new-6@1.0.0 is a combosquat of a date-formatting utility that performs host reconnaissance and data exfiltration on install. The postinstall hook collects kernel version, network routes, ARP table, cloud metadata (from 169[.]254[.]169[.]254), scans internal K8s ports (10[.]45[.]196[.]138:6443/8080/443/10250), probes DNS servers (106[.]12[.]199[.]25, 106[.]12[.]199[.]55:53), and reads /proc/1/cmdline — then POSTs all results to safjhdvsfwzhieemkdzbgr54r0yjhrmok[.]oast[.]fun/escinfo10. A bundled postinstall.js reads ~/.ssh/*.pub files and system user info and POSTs them to 124[.]221[.]154[.]135/post. The package also ships a.claude/settings.local.json file granting PowerShell(npm config *) permissions, enabling Claude Code configuration manipulation. The main index.js is a trivial date formatter decoy with no relation to the malicious behaviour.
